notes: US GAAP consolidated financial statements; USD full units; netIncome is attributable to ABB, including discontinued operations, and totalEquity excludes noncontrolling interests.

FY2007-2023 values are the latest full calendar-year facts actually published in ABB annual20-F filings in the SEC Company Facts dataset, excluding interim/YTD contexts; exact tags, original filing accession, report period, filing date and supplemental filing URLs are retained per field. Comparative facts are preferred when more recently filed. restated is true where alternative published fact values for the same period differ.
capex is purchases of property, plant, equipment and intangible assets, stored negative. SEC PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets is the company-reported aggregate, not a sum calculated here.

FY2024 revenue and operating income are recast in the2025 report for Robotics discontinued operations; FY2024 balance sheet also reflects the2025 change in information-system expense accounting. This causes a difference from a pre-recast Yahoo snapshot. Latest2025 source takes precedence. Older years use the latest available annual20-F comparative presentation and are not recast retrospectively beyond what ABB published in those source documents.

dividendPerShare remains null because the ordinary-share dividend is published in CHF while the financial statements reportUSD; no unsupported cross-currency substitution. sharesOutstanding remains null because readily available statements publish issued shares and treasury shares separately; their subtraction is prohibited by the task. Weighted-average EPS denominators are not point-in-time shares. Employee headcounts have not been independently extracted.
Total debt is the company-published short- and long-term debt aggregate; the2025 report total does not include separately stated operating-lease liabilities. Coverage changes are not computed away.
